=== Strategy ===

Due to his location, he can be tricky to engage. Ideally your raid will drop down directly onto Dagarn and then go straight into Kreizenn's room before pathing Flurries respawn. 2 Flurry guards and an AoE that interrupts casts makes him one of the tougher nToV dragons.
